# NovaQuiz

> Smart online exam platform: teachers author exams (manually or from a
> document via AI), students take them with autosaved progress and anti-cheat
> session locking, and results are graded automatically.

NovaQuiz is a web application at https://app.novaquiz.net. Accounts are free
and sign-in is passwordless (Google OAuth or an emailed magic link).

## What it does

- **Exam authoring** — a four-step wizard for single- and multiple-answer
  questions, per-question images, rich-text descriptions, explanations,
  cover images and tags.
- **AI exam generation** — upload a PDF, DOCX or text document and a language
  model drafts a full multiple-choice exam, imported as an editable draft.
- **Collections and badges** — group exams under a shared goal; passing every
  exam in a collection awards a badge automatically.
- **Exam integrity** — one active device per attempt, answers autosaved on
  every question change and every 30 seconds, resume after a lost connection,
  and automatic grading of timed-out attempts.
- **Scheduling** — publish an exam now or at a future date, with a live
  countdown and start blocked until then.
- **Interaction** — comments, likes and post-attempt problem reports routed to
  the exam owner.
- **Teacher API** — long-lived API keys for managing exams programmatically.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://novaquiz.net/): product overview, features, security, FAQ
- [Home (Tiếng Việt)](https://novaquiz.net/vi): Vietnamese overview
- [Home (日本語)](https://novaquiz.net/ja): Japanese overview
- [Brand](https://novaquiz.net/brand): logo, colour palette, typography, usage guidelines
- [Contact](https://novaquiz.net/contact): questions, feedback, partnership requests
- [Application](https://app.novaquiz.net/): the product itself (sign-in required)

## Notes

- Interface languages: Vietnamese, English, Japanese.
- Students receive starting credits on sign-up; each exam attempt costs
  credits set by its author. Upgrading a student account to a teacher account
  also costs credits.
- Application routes are not crawlable — they require authentication and are
  rendered client-side.
